# ProdRank

> AI Agent Commerce SEO (GEO) — help ecommerce stores get their products recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok when shoppers ask for product advice. ProdRank audits a store's AI visibility, generates GEO-optimized content (Schema, FAQ, descriptions), tracks AI recommendations weekly, and shows what to fix with evidence.

Key facts:
- ProdRank optimizes for AI shopping assistants, not just Google.
- Core loop: scan your store → find why AI doesn't recommend you → generate fixes (Schema/FAQ/content) → publish → re-test recommendation rate.
- Works with Shopify (App), WooCommerce (plugin), and any custom store via API.
- Honest timeline: AI awareness updates over 4–12 weeks as indexes and model knowledge refresh.

- [Free tools](https://prodrank.app/tools): Schema Validator, AI Score Checker, FAQ Generator, JSON-LD Generator, Description Analyzer, Citation Checker
- [Integrations](https://prodrank.app/integrations): Shopify App, WordPress plugin, custom API
